Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lift the crushed leaves, scatter the cold ash and leave the place looking as though it never held a story.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One hour per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One departed campsite used by up to six people; one hour.
Duration
Until new evidence exposes the departure route.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
One application per departure; no stacking Banes from repeated cleanup.
Type
Skill / Utility

Conceal ordinary evidence of your camp. The DA sets a progress target for its size and disturbance. On completion, attempts to track your departure from this site take 1 Bane. This does not erase magical marks, remove witnesses or hide occupants.

Weak
1 progress; identify one conspicuous trace still needing work.
Standard
2 progress; also learn which approach shows the clearest remaining trail.
Strong
3 progress; gain both details and preserve one useful ordinary item found while cleaning, if any is present.
